lines.text: These blocks replace the POSIX blocks of Workflow steps 2 and 4 and of Refresh. Every other block in SKILL.md runs in PowerShell as written: `"$REVIEW_DIR/review.json"` expands the same way in both shells. `<cli>` is the CLI command SKILL.md uses: the pinned `npx` command, or the local executable the user named. The blocks run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 and in PowerShell 7.
